pre_registered_thresholds.note: registered BEFORE measurement; never tuned to results (Art. XXVII)
pre_registered_thresholds.ensemble: NONE (single-attacker calibration only; majority-vote ensembles are deferred by the R412 directive)

live_measurement.live_run_driver: scripts/r487_attacker_v3_measurement.py (the deployed Space's /api/ops/calibration-attack — the production instrument code path)

attacker_ring.note: R491: the calibration is (rules x ring) — the R488 measured lesson; the gate binds terminal kill authority to THIS ring at consumption

gate_verdict.authority: attacker_calibration.resolve_state — the committed measurement record + the sealed thresholds; this script derives the verdict, never asserts it (Art. XXVII)

note: if FPR > 0.30 (or the gate state is not CALIBRATED on the measured ring), NO terminal KILL is admissible — a KILL served by the attacker is escalated to ESCALATED_OBJECTION at consumption (apply_at_consumption), never executed.  The old calibration state is not reused indefinitely: the gate reads the committed measurement for the current instrument version, and a missing / unreadable record is UNKNOWN_NOT_CALIBRATED (fail-closed).
